instruction: Add a 0.4 m square table entirely inside the rectangle.

clarificationInstruction: Use exactly one cube in total. Choose either side of the same marked line, keep it 0.30 m in all dimensions and leave at least 0.20 m clear between its whole footprint and the line. Preserve all existing model objects.

instruction: Add a small table inside this line.

Add a floor-standing cabinet below this wall rectangle, centred along its width, with its back 0.10 m from the marked wall. Make it 0.60 m wide, 0.30 m deep and 0.80 m high. Use the outline as location context, keep the cabinet on the room floor, and preserve all existing objects.
